name: Thinking-history retention pilot
design_note: Small mechanical pilot (4 tasks per arm); measures model behaviour, not solve rate. No performance verdict was registered.

runs.label: pilot
runs.task_set: 4 public gold-validated tasks outside the 48-task development panel, chosen earlier by a seeded rule

THINK_DROP.description: earlier reasoning removed from the conversation history

THINK_KEEP.description: earlier reasoning kept on earlier assistant tool-call turns

registered_thresholds.K1: thinking active on >= 90% of completed tool-bearing calls
registered_thresholds.K2: max reasoning tokens <= 544 (512 budget + 32 for markers)
registered_thresholds.K3: no-tool-call turns <= 5% and corrupted calls <= 15% of traced calls
registered_thresholds.K4: no finish_reason length and <= 4 context-window overflows
registered_thresholds.K5: history as configured: THINK_DROP, no request carries earlier reasoning; THINK_KEEP, >= 90% of requests with an earlier assistant turn carry reasoning on at least one of them
registered_thresholds.labels: K1 or K2 fails -> BROKEN; K2 not evaluable -> NOT EVALUABLE; K3-K5 pass -> MECHANICALLY CLEAN; otherwise CLEAN WITH ISSUES

related_held_experiment.description: Paired 48-task experiment on the development panel: frozen thinking-off agent at temperature 0.2 vs the identical agent at temperature 1.0 (model-card standard sampling), asking whether the repetition behaviour is a product of near-greedy decoding. Preregistration and a verdict-structure amendment were frozen and validated, but the run was never launched; no data exist and no conclusion is drawn.
